### 2026-10-07 — Today I worked on my Starbie project in Tinkercad. I built and tested the Arduino Uno circuit, connected the 16x2 I2C LCD, temperature sensor, soil moisture sensor, four buttons, and tilt sensor. I al

**5h**

Today I worked on my Starbie project in Tinkercad. I built and tested the Arduino Uno circuit, connected the 16x2 I2C LCD, temperature sensor, soil moisture sensor, four buttons, and tilt sensor. I also wrote and tested the Arduino code and fixed the LCD I2C address and sensor setup. The prototype is now working and can display temperature, soil moisture, system status, and movement detection.
